tx.¿Necesito ser profe de Yoga para hacerlo: Do I need to be a Yoga teacher to take it?
tx.No. El Posgrado está pensado especialmen: No. The Postgraduate Program is designed especially for working teachers, but people who aren't teaching yet and want to seriously deepen their Yoga practice and knowledge are also welcome to take part.
tx.¿Y si no puedo estar en el horario en vi: What if I can't make the live sessions?
tx.Todas las clases quedan grabadas y se en: All classes are recorded and sent out on Wednesdays via YouTube. You can watch them whenever you like, and you have lifetime access to the material.
tx.¿Puedo hacer un solo módulo?: Can I take just one module?
tx.Sí. Cada módulo es un curso de 4 clases: Yes. Each module is a 4-class course that stands on its own and costs $60.000. If you later want to continue with the others, you can.
tx.¿Las prácticas de Hatha Yoga están inclu: Are the Hatha Yoga practices included?
tx.Sí. Durante los tres meses tenés las prá: Yes. Throughout the three months you get the live online practices on Mondays and Thursdays from 19 to 20 h, plus access to the library of recorded classes on my YouTube channel.
tx.Sí, al terminar el recorrido completo re: Yes, when you complete the full program you receive a final certificate of participation.
tx.¿Desde dónde puedo cursar?: Where can I take it from?
tx.Desde cualquier lugar: todo el Posgrado: From anywhere: the whole Postgraduate Program is online via Zoom. The times listed are Argentina time.
tx.Escribime por WhatsApp y te paso los med: Write to me on WhatsApp and I'll send you the available payment methods. You can join at any time.
